Name: Coca-Cola European Partners PLC
Description: Coca-Cola European Partners PLC (CCEP) is a leading beverage company headquartered in Uxbridge, United Kingdom, and is one of the largest independent Coca-Cola bottlers globally. The firm specializes in the production, distribution, and sale of a diverse portfolio of ready-to-drink non-alcoholic beverages, including iconic brands such as Coca-Cola, Fanta, and Sprite, catering to a wide spectrum of consumer preferences across multiple markets. CCEP is committed to sustainability and innovation, continually enhancing its operations to reduce environmental impact while maximizing efficiency, which positions it strategically in the evolving beverage landscape. With a strong emphasis on customer collaboration and market growth, CCEP aims to drive sales and profitability while contributing to the communities it serves.
Address: PEMBERTON HOUSE, UXBRIDGE, UNITED KINGDOM, UB8 1EZ
